purpose: Bound conditional service substitution and price sensitivity using independent published service schedules. These are not buyers, orders, contracts or willingness to pay for AGI ALPHA.

sources.publisher: Research Institute of the McGill University Health Centre Bioinformatics Platform
sources.currency: CAD inferred from local institutional context; schedule excerpt itself uses dollar sign; currency must be confirmed before binding pricing
sources.service: Single Cell analysis: preprocessing/QC, clustering and UMAP, annotation/subclustering, differential expression and pathway enrichment.
sources.terms: Informational prices only; quotation required. Industry must contact the platform. No contact initiated.
sources.comparability: Standard single-cell analysis is a stronger/wider obligation than condition-mean interaction forecasting. Its project price is not an admissible direct AGI ALPHA price or forecast margin.

sources.currency: USD inferred from US institutional context; confirm before contracting
sources.service: Single-cell RNA-seq pipeline plus applicable annotation and differential/pathway analyses.
sources.terms: Complex designs may require more time; service priced hourly plus storage.
sources.comparability: Evidence that complete analysis substitutes exist and charge for project obligations. Not evidence that a standalone interaction prediction report commands this rate.

sources.publisher: Lady Davis Institute Flow Cytometry Facility
sources.comparability: Different flow-cytometry modality; related analysis service only, not an equivalent Perturb-seq forecast comparator.
sources.terms: External users request appointment; instrument/assistance, booking and cancellation obligations apply. No appointment requested.

offering_under_test.description: Reproducible prioritization/evidence package for non-additive combinatorial perturbation responses under a frozen scope and held-out evaluation.
not_included: Biological replicate certainty absent from published means
Guaranteed discovery of therapeutically actionable interactions
acceptance_requirements: Exact admissible source and readout panel
Useful improvement against qualified complete matched-data alternatives
Original sources, dependencies and limits disclosed

free_complete_software_alternatives: Published additive baseline with exact single-condition means
Regularized linear models with equal training/tuning information
substitution.critical_limit: A free algorithm is not automatically a free completed service, but its existence prevents attributing an arbitrary full core-facility price to a small report.

conditional_model_authority.may_use: Explicit prospective sensitivity ranges with zero participation included, disclosed non-equivalent service scopes, and no inferred guaranteed orders.
may_not_use: Published comparator list price as actual AGI ALPHA revenue
Predicted experimental savings as independent willingness to pay
CPU seconds alone as full monetary cost
Invented human staffing overhead for autonomous enterprise
Unavailable historical costs replaced by zero

profit_conditions.negative_to_positive_complete_cost_claim: UNKNOWN until both qualified service routes and all full costs are bounded for the same obligations.
profit_conditions.investment: Defer unless post-obligation unrestricted simulated earned cash is sufficient; positive accounting profit alone does not fund construction.
profit_conditions.outside_option: Non-entry/free self-service and strong conventional paid service remain explicit alternatives.
profit_conditions.AGI_ALPHA_value_capture: UNKNOWN; beneficiary savings are not automatic licensing earnings.

source_limit: Public schedule facts were read29Oct2026. Third-party service scope, currencies, current availability and procurement terms require exact independent confirmation before operational use. No newterms accepted.
